docs.title: lo3
docs.text: lo3 is an interpreted token based programming language written in C.

docs.title: Progress
docs.text:
(-> tag: v0.3.0)

Feature Status ALU Operations ✅ Control Flow ✅ Func Calling ✅ Input/STDIN ✅ Output/STDOUT ✅ Operating with vars ✅ Operating with g[] ⚠️ %2% Manually exiting with 0 or 1 ✅ Auto exiting ✅

docs.text:
This syntax require lo3, at least tag: v0.3.0, all basics work on v0.3.0 as well as v0.3.1,

but please try to use v0.3.1, as it is the newer and feature rich one.
